We are looking for motivated teammates—especially those skilled in data analysis, coding, Earth science, or storytelling—who love problem-solving and want to build an impactful project together. Join us!
summary:
**TerraTrack – Exploring Earth's Environmental Changes Through NASA Data**

TerraTrack is an interactive environmental data analysis and visualization platform designed to help users understand how Earth's environmental systems change over time. Using data from NASA's POWER API, the platform allows users to explore historical environmental information based on geographical coordinates and selected time periods.

The dashboard focuses on three key environmental parameters: air temperature, precipitation, and root-zone soil wetness. It retrieves NASA data, organizes it into annual records, and presents the results through interactive charts, data tables, and statistical analysis. Users can examine average values, identify maximum and minimum readings, compare changes across years, and investigate long-term environmental trends.

Developed using Python, Streamlit, Pandas, Plotly, and the NASA POWER API, TerraTrack transforms complex environmental datasets into an accessible and user-friendly experience.

The main objective is to make NASA's Earth observation data easier to explore and interpret, encourage environmental awareness, and help users discover meaningful patterns in our changing planet through data-driven investigation.
details:
TerraTrack – Exploring Earth's Environmental Changes Through NASA Data

TerraTrack is an interactive environmental data exploration and visualization platform that helps users understand how Earth's environmental systems change over time. It uses NASA's POWER API to retrieve historical environmental data based on geographical coordinates and selected time periods.

The platform focuses on three important environmental parameters: air temperature, precipitation, and root-zone soil wetness. Users can enter latitude and longitude coordinates, choose a range of years, and retrieve relevant NASA data. TerraTrack processes the information into annual records and presents it through interactive charts, data tables, and statistical summaries.

The dashboard allows users to explore average, minimum, and maximum values, identify changes between years, and examine long-term environmental trends. It also includes a question-answering feature that helps users investigate the loaded dataset through simple natural-language questions.

Benefits and Intended Impact

TerraTrack makes environmental information easier to access, understand, and explore. Instead of requiring users to interpret complex raw datasets, it presents important environmental patterns through a simple and interactive interface. It can support students, educators, environmental enthusiasts, and researchers in exploring changes in local and regional environmental conditions.

The intended impact is to encourage environmental awareness, promote the use of open NASA Earth science data, and help people make more informed observations about our changing planet.

Tools and Technologies

The project was developed using Python, Streamlit, Pandas, Plotly, and the NASA POWER API. Python handles data processing and analysis, Pandas organizes the datasets, Plotly creates interactive visualizations, and Streamlit provides the web-based dashboard interface.

Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of TerraTrack is its approach to making NASA environmental data accessible through location-based exploration. Users can investigate different geographical locations and time periods using one dashboard, compare environmental parameters, and discover patterns through visual analysis. The integrated question-answering feature makes exploring the data more approachable.

Factors Considered During Development

During development, we considered accessibility, simplicity, data clarity, usability, and the importance of using reliable scientific data. We designed the platform to work through a web browser without requiring specialized hardware. We also considered how to present complex environmental information in a way that is understandable to users with different levels of technical knowledge.

Through TerraTrack, we aim to transform publicly available NASA data into an accessible tool for environmental exploration and learning.
